items.description: Landlord must supply electricity to the Premises sufficient to meet the Electricity Consumption Threshold.
items.span_text: Landlord shall furnish electricity to the Premises sufficient to meet the Electricity Consumption Threshold.

items.description: Landlord must provide back-up power meeting the Back-Up Power Specifications at all times except during maintenance operations and Force Majeure events.
items.span_text: In addition, Landlord shall furnish back-up power for the Premises sufficient to meet the Back-Up Power Specifications, at all times except during maintenance operations and Force Majeure events.

items.description: Landlord must provide HVAC so the average temperature and humidity of the Premises meet the HVAC Specifications.
items.span_text: Landlord shall furnish HVAC to the Premises sufficient to cause the average temperature and humidity of the Premises (measured below the raised floor of the Premises) to meet the HVAC Specifications.

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant an Outage Credit for each separate interruption of essential services, sized per the duration tables.
items.span_text: Upon the occurrence of each Separate/Independent Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services, Tenant shall be entitled to an Outage Credit in the amount set forth opposite the duration of such Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services in Table 2.A.(1)-A and 2.A.(1)-B, below, as applicable:
items.trigger: Upon the occurrence of each Separate/Independent Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services

items.description: Landlord must credit Tenant against Rent a redacted amount per Security/Access Incident and per day it remains unresolved.
items.span_text: Tenant shall be entitled to a credit (“Security/Access Credits”) against Rent in the amount of $[***] for each Security/Access Incident and $[***] for each day that any Security/Access Incident is unresolved.
items.trigger: Any breach by Landlord of its obligations with respect to Security or Access

items.description: Landlord must have a SOC 2 Audit of the Datacenter performed by a qualified independent auditor at least once every twelve months.
items.span_text: Landlord shall cause a SOC 2 Audit of the Datacenter be performed at least once every twelve months by a qualified independent auditor.

items.description: Landlord must pay Tenant any credit accrued in the final month of the Term within thirty days after the Term expires.
items.span_text: such credit shall be applied as a credit towards Tenant’s Base Rent due in the immediately following month of the Term; provided, however, in the event that a credit accrues during the final month of the Term, Landlord will pay to Tenant the amount of such credit within thirty (30) days following the expiration of the Term.
items.trigger: in the event that a credit accrues during the final month of the Term

items.description: Landlord must notify Tenant as soon as reasonably practicable after curing an interruption, security/access incident, or SOC 2 non-compliance.
items.span_text: Once Landlord has rectified a particular Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services, Security/Access Incident, or SOC 2 non-compliance, Landlord shall provide notice of such rectification or cure to Tenant as soon as is reasonably practicable thereafter.
items.trigger: Once Landlord has rectified a particular Interruption of Landlord’s Essential Services, Security/Access Incident, or SOC 2 non-compliance

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease after a Continuous Outage by timely delivering the Continuous Outage Termination Notice.
items.span_text: In the event of a Continuous Outage, Tenant may terminate this Lease by timely delivery of the Continuous Outage Termination Notice to Landlord.
items.trigger: In the event of a Continuous Outage

items.description: Landlord must reimburse Tenant's reasonable costs of moving its Personal Property to a new location if Tenant terminates for a Continuous Outage.
items.span_text: If Tenant exercises its termination right under this Paragraph B, then Landlord shall reimburse Tenant for the reasonable costs incurred by Tenant in moving Tenant’s Personal Property from the Tenant Space to a new location.
items.trigger: If Tenant exercises its termination right under this Paragraph B

items.description: Tenant may terminate the Lease after a Chronic Outage by timely delivering the Chronic Outage Termination Notice.
items.span_text: In the event of a Chronic Outage, Tenant may terminate this Lease by timely delivery of the Chronic Outage Termination Notice to Landlord.
items.trigger: In the event of a Chronic Outage
